blocks.text: A faith your child can know, practice, and carry with them. We are committed to forming students who know God , love His presence , and carry His Kingdom .

At Kingdom Heights, students encounter the Christian faith through Scripture, worship, prayer, relationships, and mission. Every part of school life is designed to help them develop a faith that is deeply rooted, personally owned, and faithfully lived.
GOD'S KINGDOM FIRST ✳︎ REGNUM DEI PRIMUM ✳︎

items.title: WE GATHER
items.text: Chapel Students gather regularly for worship, biblical teaching, prayer, testimony, and response. Chapel gives our school a shared spiritual rhythm and creates space for students to encounter God together.

items.title: WE LEARN
items.text: Daily Bible classes and Summit Ministries curriculum Students study Scripture every day through age-appropriate Bible courses and the Summit Ministries curriculum. They develop biblical literacy, learn to think carefully about worldview, and engage the questions shaping their generation.

items.title: WE PRAY
items.text: Staff, Faculty, and Students Pray Throughout the Day Creative and strategic in equal measure, our marketing director brings fresh ideas to every campaign. They turn insights into action and help our message resonate with the right audience.

items.title: WE INTEGRATE
items.text: Christ-centered education Christian faith shapes the way every subject is taught. Students explore literature, science, history, mathematics, the arts, and culture within the larger story of God’s creation, redemption, and Kingdom. This structure allows you to include all the everyday spiritual activity without making the page feel cluttered.

items.title: WE STEWARD LEADERS
items.text: All Flame Society An invitation to pursue a life fully given to God. The All Flame Society calls students toward wholehearted Christian maturity. Through spiritual practices, shared commitments, mentorship, and community, students are invited to become people whose minds, affections, relationships, and work are shaped by the love of God.

items.title: WE GO OUT
items.text: Age-appropriate mission experiences help students encounter the global Church, serve across cultures, and understand God’s work throughout the world.

blocks.text: Deeply rooted. Joyfully diverse. Centered on Jesus.

Kingdom Heights was founded by The Rock Family Worship Center out of a desire to serve families throughout the Tennessee Valley. While our school was born from a local church, our community includes families from many churches, denominations, cultures, and backgrounds.

We are united by historic Christian faith, the authority of Scripture, and the lordship of Jesus Christ. We believe students are strengthened when they encounter the richness of the wider Body of Christ and learn to pursue unity without losing conviction.
Kingdom Heights grew from the ministry and vision of The Rock Family Worship Center , a diverse, Spirit-filled church that has served North Alabama for more than twenty-five years.

Our students come from a wide range of Christian traditions and churches. We are united around the essential truths of the historic Christian faith while creating room for families to hold and understand their denominational distinctives with maturity, humility, and mutual respect.

Our school reflects the beautiful diversity of God’s Kingdom. Our multiethnic student body brings together families from many cultures and backgrounds, giving students the opportunity to learn, worship, and grow within a community that reflects the breadth of Christ’s Church.

We stand within the historic Christian faith, confessing the truths expressed in the Apostles’ Creed and Nicene Creed. We affirm the authority of Scripture, the lordship of Jesus Christ, the work of the Holy Spirit, and the Church’s calling to share the gospel and participate in God’s mission in the world.
